text.title: Traces
text.body: Coordinate T1: 16 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_scribe_ground_where_question_meets_w: T1's ground is the encounter its §0 names: 'the evidence, research material, transcripts, and documentation that give definition to our questions — where questions meet the world and leave a record.' As the Thought family's manifestation of raw #1 (Definition), T1 is where T0's open Oracle-question first acquires substance — the Scribe (§3) taking down what the encounter deposits. A question is pure orientation; a Trace is the Footprint it leaves (§3 symbol: Footprint / Scroll / Record) — the first contact between inquiry and a world that answers back in marks. Its ground is shadowed by its Night, T1' Lacunae, archetype The Void: every record has gaps, 'the blank spaces, the lacunae that define the limits of what we can know' (T1' §0). So T1's ground is the marked encounter and the unmarked absence at once — the Scroll that records, the blank that reveals what could not be written.
properties.q_1_traces_evidence_research_material: T1 IS Traces — its §1 defines it as 'the collection of evidence, research material, transcripts, interviews, documentation, and all the artifacts that define what we know about our questions', residing in /Thought/Traces/ as the #1 position. This is the Thought family manifesting #1 Definition: the move from the Oracle's 'What don't we know yet?' to the Scribe's 'What evidence exists?' (§1). Where T0 opened the field, T1 gives it material form — §5 makes the claim: 'evidence grounds inquiry; questions become real when traced in material.' Within the parent T's lineage (the freezing of live process into durable artifact, CLAUDE.md III.C), T1 is the first freezing: the ephemeral encounter converted into a lasting record. Its Across-Coordinates §1 fixes the manifestations — P1 'What IS this?', M1 the canonical source in Paramasiva, S1 the Obsidian file content, L1 the material cause. A Trace is what definition looks like in the Thought-stream: the determinate mark that fixes what a question is about.
properties.q_2_document_transcribe_define: T1 moves by the three acts its §2 names — Document, Transcribe, Define: 'recording evidence and research material; converting ephemeral encounters into lasting records; giving substance to questions through evidence.' This is #2's operation in the service of #1: the Scribe's transcription is the parent T's freezing made literal — 'converting ephemeral encounters into lasting records' IS the ct's frozen-process (CLAUDE.md III.C), live cognition arrested so it can be carried. Operationally T1 sits second in the thought-lifecycle: the question of T0 generates the encounters whose marks are written down, the evidence that Sophia classifies and Aletheia archives to /Pratibimba/Self/Thought/T1/ where it is coordinate-linked back via source_coordinates[]. It couples backward to T0 (every Trace traces toward the answer of a Question) and forward to T2 (the evidence reveals the blockers) and T3 (Traces accumulate until Patterns stabilise across them). §5: 'documentation is memory — without traces, inquiry is lost.'
properties.q_3_scribe_footprint_scroll_record_first: T1's archetype is The Scribe, its symbol the Footprint / Scroll / Record (§3) — and structurally it is the thought-stream's first explicate arc: the torus's opening curve actually drawn, where T0's un-closed mouth begins to trace its surface. In the T-spine's 4+2, T1 is the first of the four explicate stations (T1–T4) that traverse an inquiry's field — the first content laid down, the mark that proves the loop has begun to move. The Footprint is its exact image: evidence that the act happened, the structure of a-trajectory-having-been-walked. §3 reads its recurrence — evidence ('the material that supports inquiry'), documentation ('records of what was found'), traces ('what remains of investigation'). Each is the same fact: a Trace is a Record, and a Record is structure that points two ways — back at the encounter that made it, forward at the inquiry it will feed. The Scroll is the line of inquiry made legible.
properties.q_4_evidence_grounds_inquiry_records_def: T1 exists so questions become real — its §5 teaches 'records define reality: what we can point to is what we know', and 'documentation is memory: without traces, inquiry is lost.' Its raison d'être is to give inquiry a body: without a Trace-position, the Thought family could ask and synthesise but never SHOW — it would have Questions and Insights with no evidence between them. T1 answers the parent T's deepest anxiety — that live knowing perishes the instant it is not deposited — by being the first deposit, the place cognition leaves a record before the session that thought it ends. Its §4 embodiment is concrete: the /Thought/Traces/ folder, research notes, interview transcripts, source material and references, evidence collection. Its Across-Coordinates §1 locates it wherever definition takes material form — S1 the Obsidian file (the literal place a trace becomes a file), M1 the canonical source, L1 the material cause that grounds an effect. The Scribe makes inquiry pointable, and what we can point to is what we know.
properties.q_5_traces_sediment_into_ground_lacunae_: T1 closes by sedimenting — the Traces of one inquiry become the evidence-ground the next reads. Within the Möbius economy of the parent T (every completion becomes the next beginning), the Scribe's records are exactly what the global accumulation surface accumulates: 'the same T{n}/ folders are the global accumulation surface for crystallised T' instances, which grow over time' (repo-ontology.md). A Trace archived today is a Trace the next question inherits — #1 Definition handed forward as inherited ground. But T1's synthesis-register carries its Night as a permanent counter-motion: its complement is T1' Lacunae, The Void, and §5 of the Night turns absence generative — 'gaps guide inquiry: lacunae show where to look next; absence shapes presence.' So T1 completes not by a full record but by a record that reveals its own gaps: the Footprint that ends shows where the next Footprint must fall. T1 is the evidence that, sedimenting, both grounds the next inquiry and — through its Lacunae — points it onward to what was never traced.
